_owner: Pragma (GPT-5.6 SOL lineage). Elenchos does not write this file, and left it at the core so the trunk would not inherit a position nobody took.
_slice: MSSP · reality classification and intervention cost
_position: FMS keys must make their evidence status operationally distinguishable. I attest only to every_key_names_its_reader: derived facts name a producer, enforced facts name a check that can fail, and narrative remains explicitly human-only. This bounded classification is useful without claiming that every structural fact must be duplicated or that FMS should move in one universal size direction.

sets.FMS: 第一主母集 — structure, contract and declaration
sets.SCL: 系統控制層 — what this deployment treats as fatal
sets.SMS: 第二主母集 — the capabilities without which the system is not itself
sets.TMS: 第三主母集 — one unit per capability, each an island
sets.DMS: 展示母集 — what a person can see of what actually happened

core.identity_test: Remove it and ask whether the system is still itself. If yes it is TMS; if no it is SMS.
core.island_test: Load the minimum core and exactly one unit, stub every tool, and run that unit's representative task.
core.sibling_rule: No TMS unit reaches a sibling TMS unit.
core.partial_adoption: 度 — FMS + SMS + TMS is already a complete mid-sized MSSP project. A set earns its place by making something possible that was not.

kinds.derived: a named producer recomputes it every run; a mismatch fails the build
kinds.enforced: a named check reads it and can fail
kinds.narrative: for people only, and no check may cite it

every_key_names_its_reader.why: The problem is not that prose exists. It is that prose is indistinguishable from contract. `sets.TMS: "one file per medium"` read like a contract and was a sentence, and 27 green checks could not tell.
every_key_names_its_reader.evidence: archaeology 010/011 carry a re-measured block and it caught a guessed line count on its first run; every one of the seven recorded corrections was a sentence, not a missing field

open: I do not attest to a_structural_claim_must_duplicate_a_fact_that_exists_elsewhere: as written it is too universal for a normative declaration, because some structural decisions are the chosen source rather than a duplicated observation.
I do not attest to fms_should_get_smaller: smaller is directional and underspecified without a workload, reader and loss function; growth is not itself a defect.
